newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Holderbank says two German units to merge.
newsitem.headline: Holderbank says two German units to merge.

text.p: Holderbank Financiere Glarus Ltd said two German companies in the group would merge this year.
Alsen-Breitenburg Zement- und Kalkwerke GmbH (AB) and Nordcement AG (NC), the two leading cement companies in northern Germany, will merge this year to form Alsen AG, the company said in a statement.

"Pursuant to resolutions passed by the supervisory boards of NC and Breitenburger Portland-Cement Fabrik AG (BPCF) -- the latter holds a majority interest in AB -- AB and NC are to merge this year to form Alsen AG," it said.
"The move is designed not only to merge the operational units of the two structures, but also to streamline and realign the historically complex holding structure," it added.
Holderbank has more than 90 percent of both NC and BPCF, and BPCF in turn holds 80 percent of AB's capital, it said.
